name: Dr. Andi Amran Sulaiman
title: Minister of Agriculture
bio: Dr. Andi Amran Sulaiman oversees the national drive for complete food self-sufficiency (Swasembada Pangan). Under President Prabowo’s direction, the Ministry accelerates modern rice and corn cultivation, expands agricultural mechanization, safeguards water irrigation networks, and guarantees direct fertilizer distribution to farmers.
